name: Parks Signs
description:
This dataset lists park signs across New York City, with 5,000 sampled records and 24 fields. Each row describes a single sign and includes its location (borough, community board, council district, park district, police precinct, ZIP code, and geographic point), the park or property it belongs to (property name, sub-property name, and property identifiers), and details about the sign itself such as sign type, sign code, status, mounting surface, and the languages displayed (primary, second, and third language codes). It also records the amenity type associated with the sign and operating hours where relevant.

The data could be used to map sign locations and coverage by neighborhood or district, audit signage for language accessibility and compliance, assess sign conditions and types across parks, or support maintenance and wayfinding planning for parks departments and researchers.
